title: PI-ResNet strain-level lensed-pair statistic: code, trained networks and per-pair scores

creators.name: Huang, Jiaqing
creators.affiliation: Jiangsu Sungo Intelligent Technology Research Center Co., Ltd.

creators.name: Yuan, Yong
creators.affiliation: Institute of Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description:
Software release for the ApJS revision (manuscript AAS82367) of the PI-ResNet study of strongly lensed gravitational-wave pairs. Version 3.0.0 supersedes v2.2.2: the networks are retrained and re-evaluated on realistic populations (ler: GWTC-3 power-law-plus-peak binary black holes, elliptical power-law galaxy lenses with external shear) at O4 (H1, L1, V1) and Einstein Telescope (three ET-D interferometers from 5 Hz) sensitivity, with multi-detector two-stream input.

Files:

  • lensing_classification-src.tar.gz: snapshot of the code repository (github.com/zqk-7k/lensing_classification, release tag apjs-revision-v3.0.0, commit 0bbc352, on the main branch; the commit is also in lensing_classification-src.commit.txt). The v3 analysis is in experiments/apjs_revision/v3/ (protocol PROTOCOL_V3.md, results RESULTS_V3.md).
  • pi-resnet-v3-analysis.tar.gz (3.1 GB): trained networks (best-validation checkpoints, configs, training histories, splits) of PI-ResNet, the reduced-input, stream-A-only, early-fusion and CQT-DeiT networks at ET and O4; pair manifests; per-pair scores of every network (bf16 and fp32, with and without the time-delay statistic); frozen-analysis comparison tables; point-mass robustness set; figure data (CSV); staged-search cost model; timing benchmarks. MANIFEST.sha256 inside lists every file.
  • pi-resnet-gw-lensing-frozen-v2.tar.gz (2.65 GB) with its .sha256, archive_info.json and filelist.txt: the complete reproducibility archive of the earlier version (v2.2.2, repository tag apjs-resubmission-v2.2.2), included here because the previous version of this record was published without it.

The simulated strain catalogues (19 GB) are a separate Zenodo record, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24049603. Code: MIT license.
